topic: What trade-offs exist between array size and radiation efficiency for SIW arrays in high-gain inter-satellite antennas?
consensus_response: In high-gain SIW (Small Integer-Weighted) arrays, larger arrays enhance gain but introduce significant insertion loss due to increased waveguide length. This tradeoff is influenced by material properties and simulation techniques, impacting overall performance.  Effective area expands radiation patterns, potentially boosting gain but reducing directivity, affecting angular coverage and efficiency. Advanced simulations help optimize array sizes while maintaining compact configurations and acceptable losses.
